Sounds - sources and licences
=============================

Every file here is CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication): free to use, redistribute and change, with
no attribution required. They are credited anyway. Downloaded 2026-10-05 as Freesound's HQ previews
(128 kbps MP3); swap in the original file from the page for full quality.

None of these is a recording of another phone's ringtone or alert.

ring-signal.mp3   "musical "ios/samsung"-type ringtone (FREE)" by chockingonuwilliamiloveyou (Freesound #844279)
                  https://freesound.org/people/chockingonuwilliamiloveyou/sounds/844279/

ring-marimba.mp3  "Marimba loop" by BrickDeveloper171 (Freesound #521390)
                  https://freesound.org/people/BrickDeveloper171/sounds/521390/

                  https://freesound.org/people/xkeril/sounds/753346/

                  https://freesound.org/people/G_RonnyMo/sounds/555055/

                  https://freesound.org/people/fennelliott/sounds/379416/

                  https://freesound.org/people/Squidems/sounds/709944/

Replacing a sound: put an .mp3 with the same name in this folder (web/dist/sounds/ on a server that
is already built). Adding a ringtone or text tone: drop in ring-<name>.mp3 or tone-<name>.mp3, then
add the name to RINGTONES or TEXTTONES and a line to CLIPS in web/src/sound.ts, and rebuild.
The dial pad tones and the ringback are generated in code, not recorded.
